QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] Muto's Choice
QuestInfo.0: It's the moment of truth. Master Lyck and Simia present their food to Muto. Which will Muto choose?
QuestInfo.1: It's the moment of truth. Master Lyck and Simia present their food to Muto. Which will Muto choose?
QuestInfo.2: Muto was furious to see more of Master Lyck's food. But he calmed down once he tasted Simia's dish. As Gulla approached, Muto rose to drive him back. Success!
